work.description: The act addresses the assembled bishops on current errors after the definition. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF22535-22536 reads: HABITA 1N CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE 1X. DECEMBRIS ANNO MDCCCLIV-. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
